description: Source code for GDB stub implementation in Zephyr RTOS, handling remote debugging protocol, memory access, breakpoints, and GDB communication loop.

methods.name: find_memory_region
methods.description: Finds a memory region descriptor that contains a given memory block.

methods.name: gdb_mem_can_read
methods.description: Checks if a memory region can be read.

methods.name: gdb_mem_can_write
methods.description: Checks if a memory region can be written to.

methods.name: gdb_bin2hex
methods.description: Converts binary data to hexadecimal string.

methods.name: gdb_send_packet
methods.description: Sends a GDB protocol packet with data and checksum.

methods.name: gdb_get_packet
methods.description: Receives a GDB protocol packet, verifying checksum.

methods.name: gdb_mem_read
methods.description: Reads memory from a specified address and length.

methods.name: gdb_mem_write
methods.description: Writes memory to a specified address and length.

methods.name: gdb_send_exception
methods.description: Sends an exception packet to GDB.

methods.name: z_gdb_main_loop
methods.description: Main loop for GDB remote debugging communication.
